title: 對索洛夫社會主義聯邦共和國不當行為之抗議聲明 Statement of Protest Against the Misconduct of the Solov Socialist Federal Republic
author: 大陽君皇 Emperor of the GSE
context:
近日於西元2026 1/21日索洛夫社會主義聯邦共和國當局宣稱MikeTong先生逝世的消息，而事後多方包含索洛夫國親自證實此消息是虛假的，而此事件也引發部份國家的不滿，因此我國友邦桃花民主共和國選擇進行斷交。

但事後索洛夫卻以「非社會主義國家」詞彙與禁止入境等措施回應，我代表大陽聯合帝國表示強烈的譴責並要求索國應給予桃花國與國際社會一個回應，因為事後雖然索洛夫發表自檢聲明等，但包含造成意識型態對立說詞與先前制裁行動並沒有得到合理解決。

我們也再次督促索洛夫貴國應銘記(平戶中平事件)的爭議，事關人命無論玩笑對戲，不得由微國家政府力量傳遞造成恐慌和錯誤訊息，我們也因此事情重新審視大陽與索洛夫外交關係。
 On January 21, 2026, the authorities of the Socialist Federal Republic of Solov announced the death of Mr. Mike Tong. However, multiple parties, including the SFRS himself, clarified this as an ingenuine message. This incident sparked discontent among some countries, resulting in our ally, the Democratic Republic of Peach Blossom, to sever diplomatic ties.

However, Solov responded by using the term 'non-socialist country' and imposing entry bans. On behalf of the Great Sun United Empire, we strongly condemn this action and demand a response from the SFRS to the Peach Blossom and the international community. Although Solov issued a self-criticism statement, the rhetoric that created ideological conflict and the previous sanctions have not been adequately addressed.

We also urge Solov to remember the controversy surrounding the (Hirado Nakahei incident). When it comes to human life, no joke or play is acceptable; a small government should not spread panic and misinformation. We are also re-evaluating the diplomatic relations between the GSE and SFRS in response to this incident.
